statement.essentials: Most of these tumours grow in the outer part of the gland; some grow in the inner part, in the lower tail, or in the small separate lobe in front.
statement.anatomy: Pleomorphic adenomas mostly lie in the superficial portion of the parotid, only a minority in the deep lobe. Tumours also arise in the tail of the gland and in accessory parotid tissue along the duct.
statement.clinical: A narrative review states that about 10% of pleomorphic adenomas lie in the deep lobe, whereas a tertiary-centre surgical series had 147 deep-lobe and 222 superficial-lobe cases. A systematic review of accessory parotid gland neoplasms covered 187 patients, 61.5% with benign tumours.

limitations: The shares differ widely because referral centres see more deep-lobe tumours and imaging finds more of them; they say nothing about an individual tumour. Accessory-gland tumours of all histologies are pooled in the last figure.
disagreement: About 10% deep-lobe in a narrative review against 40% (147 of 369) in a tertiary-centre series.
